{{Top}}
{{Quote|Warning: Fuel cells near depletion.|On [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] fuel computer|<ref name="Children of the Force">{{TCW|Children of the Force}}</ref>}}
A '''fuel cell''', also referred to as a '''fuel core''' or '''fuel rod''', was a part of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] or [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] that contained its [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]]. They were manufactured through the use of [[chemical churner]]s and [[impact sifter]]s.<ref name="DH">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}, p. 196</ref> [[Plutonium]] combined with [[Uranium/Legends|uranium]] was put into [[starfighter]] fuel cells.

==History==
[[File:FuelRod.png|thumb|250px|Isotope-5 fuel rods.]]
Around [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR updates|2.0}}</ref> [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] developed [[isotope-5]] [[Isotope-5 fuel rod|fuel rods]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], the fuel rods were contested between the Cartel and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in order to escape [[Makeb]] aboard [[the Ark]].

[[Wiborg Jenssen/Legends|Wiborg Jenssen]] was a company that produced fuel cells for the [[Twin ion engine/Legends|twin ion engines]] of [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] craft. Fuel cells like the ones in [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]] were powered with a liquid metal fuel.<ref name="Millennium Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>

[[Chez O'nder]] once had to try to eat a blaster's fuel cell after losing a bet, and it fused his lips together.<ref name="CorDawn">{{LivingForce|Coruscani Dawn}}</ref>
